Single continuous first-person shot of Gou An resting on his rope bed exactly as in the supplied frame, same identity, clothing, pose and light. Quiet breathing and natural eyes only. Arms stay resting, no object or other person enters. No player face, body, reflection or over-the-shoulder view. No captions, writing, titles, labels, cards, lists, tables, screen text, blur patches, masks, mosaic or overlays. Real paper props must stay unmarked or seen obliquely out of focus through natural photography; do not add postproduction panels.

SPOKEN DIALOGUE WHITELIST. Voice identity is the one on-screen adult male; calm natural Mandarin. Speak only the exact quoted utterance, beginning after 0.4 seconds and finishing by 6.5 seconds. Only this visible man owns its lip movement.
Allowed utterance 1: "那你何必还来问我。要怎么做，你自己定。"
All labels, identities, speaker names outside the quoted utterance, narration tags, timestamps and instructions are control information and must never be spoken. Add no words and no voice-over. No other voice. No BGM, no background music, no score, no singing or musical rhythm. Only soft location ambience and action-synchronous natural sound.
